Our Mission

Time connects us all. We believe understanding global time should be intuitive, visual, and joyful. Whether you're coordinating with remote teams, planning international travel, or simply curious about the time halfway around the world, World Time Clock is here to help.

“Making global time simple, beautiful, and accessible to everyone.”

— The World Time Clock Team

Why We Built This

Four principles that guide everything we do

Real-Time Accuracy

Uses your browser's native Intl API to display precise, up-to-the-second time for every country with automatic DST adjustments.

Global Coverage

Supports all 195+ countries and their time zones, including territories and regions with unique time offsets like India (UTC+5:30).

Blazing Fast

Built with Next.js for instant loading, zero external scripts, and optimal performance across all devices and network conditions.

Beautiful Design

Inspired by modern UI principles — gradients, glass effects, and responsive cards that work beautifully on any screen size.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about World Time Clock

What is World Time Clock?

World Time Clock is a free, accurate, real-time global time zone viewer that shows current local time for every country. It helps travelers, remote workers, and businesses coordinate across time zones.

How accurate is the time displayed?

Our clocks use your device's system time combined with the IANA timezone database to ensure accuracy within seconds. All times update in real-time every second.

Do you support Daylight Saving Time (DST)?

Yes! All times automatically adjust for Daylight Saving Time where applicable. The timezone data includes DST rules for each region, ensuring you always see the correct local time.

How many countries are supported?

We support all 195+ recognized countries plus many territories and regions, covering every time zone across the globe from UTC-12 to UTC+14.

Is World Time Clock free to use?

Yes, World Time Clock is completely free with no ads, no subscriptions, and no hidden costs. We believe global time information should be accessible to everyone.

Can I use this on mobile devices?

Absolutely! Our site is fully responsive and works beautifully on smartphones, tablets, and desktop computers. The interface adapts to any screen size.
